officialText:
Section 700.1 – Add a new Informational Note No. 5 at the end of Section 700.1 to read as follows:

Informational Note No. 5: For the occupancy groups and equipment for which emergency power must be provided, transfer equipment locations, power source enclosure fire rating and other applicable requirements, see Chapter 27 of the New York City Building Code.
